items.headline: Carlos Alcaraz celebrated his ATP Finals win in a gold Rolex
items.caption: A yellow-gold Daytona with a meteorite dial.
body: It's worth around £40,000.
He also wore it when he won Wimbledon.
Style lesson: a lucky watch is a great watch.

items.headline: Vogue's Best Dressed People of 2026
items.caption: An unranked list of the year's 50 best dressed.
body: Athletes, actors and couples all made it.
Vogue calls it highly subjective.
Style lesson: confidence is the common thread.

items.headline: Hailey Bieber's jacket collection keeps growing
items.caption: Opera coats, leathers and trenches in New York.
body: On November 17 she wore a Phoebe Philo shaggy jacket.
Vogue calls it a post-quiet-luxury era.
Style lesson: let the coat be the outfit.

items.headline: An F.P. Journe sells for $11 million in Paris
items.caption: The most expensive watch ever auctioned in France.
body: It's a Tourbillon Souverain 'Souscription'.
It sold at Bonhams Paris.
Style lesson: independent watchmakers are the new blue chips.

items.headline: Wooden tile bracelets are the underground's new favourite
items.caption: Rappers like fakemink and Lil Uzi Vert are stacking them.
body: Paris brand 1199 is at the centre of the hype.
The style comes from religious souvenir shops.
How to wear it: stack a few on one wrist.

items.headline: White Mountaineering names a new creative director
items.caption: Alessandro Pungetti, longtime C.P. Company head designer.
body: He succeeds founder Yosuke Aizawa after 20 years.
His first collection is Fall 2027 in Paris.
Style lesson: technical outerwear is here to stay.

items.headline: 'The Thomas Crown Affair' is an essential menswear movie
items.caption: GQ looks back at Steve McQueen's 1968 style ahead of the reboot.
body: The 1999 remake is worth watching for the suits.
Michael B. Jordan leads the new one.
Style lesson: suede desert boots with a suit.

items.headline: Street art at intersections may make drivers safer
items.caption: Studies found fewer crashes where colourful pavement art and safety changes went in.
body: Injury crashes dropped 29% at the average intersection studied.
Researchers say the road changes also helped.

items.headline: A vending machine lets volunteers anywhere help homeless people
items.caption: Tulsa's 'BeSeen Machine' connects users to virtual volunteers by phone.
body: It hands out blankets, meals and even dog food.
The BeHeard Movement started six years ago.

items.headline: Roman glass found in a nomad noble's tomb in Mongolia
items.caption: A Xiongnu tomb held a Roman glass cup and a silver-and-crystal pendant.
body: It shows how far Silk Road trade reached.
The Xiongnu linked Rome, Han China and Korea.
